title: Irreducible lisse strata
statement:
Let $X$ be Noetherian and $F$ a constructible abelian etale sheaf on $X$.
There is a finite partition $X=\coprod_{i=1}^m S_i$ into nonempty irreducible
locally closed subschemes such that each $F|_{S_i}$ is locally constant with
finite stalks.

proof.text:
By constructibility [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], choose a finite stratification $(\iota_k:Z_k\to X)_{k<n}$ by locally closed subschemes with each $\iota_k^{-1}F$ finite locally constant; discard the empty $Z_k$. Each $Z_k$ is Noetherian: the immersion $\iota_k$ is quasi-compact (Stacks Tag 01OX) and locally of finite type (Tag 01T5), so $Z_k$ is quasi-compact and locally Noetherian (Tag 01T6). Hence [lem-weil-pbc-noetherian-finite-components] gives finitely many irreducible components $C_1,\ldots,C_r$ of $Z_k$ ($r\ge1$ as $Z_k\ne\emptyset$). For this fixed ordering put

$$
 S_i=C_i\setminus\bigcup_{j<i}C_j.
$$

Each $S_i$ is open in $C_i$. The component $C_i$ is not contained in any other component, and irreducibility implies that it is not covered by the finitely many proper closed subsets $C_i\cap C_j$ for $j\ne i$; hence $S_i$ contains the generic point of $C_i$ and, as a nonempty open subset of an irreducible space, is nonempty and irreducible. The $S_i$ are pairwise disjoint and cover $Z_k$ (every point lies in some component), and each is locally closed in $Z_k$, hence in $X$ since $\iota_k$ is a homeomorphism onto a locally closed subset. Equip $S_i$ with the reduced induced subscheme structure of the locally closed subset $S_i\subseteq Z_k$ (Stacks Tag 01J4, on an open subscheme of $Z_k$ in which $S_i$ is closed), with immersion $g_i:S_i\to Z_k$; the composite $\iota_k\circ g_i:S_i\to X$ is an immersion with image $S_i$ (Tag 02V0), i.e. a locally closed subscheme in the sense of [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions].

Since $\iota_k^{-1}F$ is finite locally constant, [lem-weil-pbc-pullback-finite-locally-constant] applied to $g_i:S_i\to Z_k$ and $\iota_k:Z_k\to X$ shows that $F|_{S_i}=(\iota_k\circ g_i)^{-1}F$ is finite locally constant, i.e. locally constant with finite geometric stalks [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves]. Doing this for the finitely many nonempty $Z_k$ gives finitely many nonempty irreducible locally closed pieces, pairwise disjoint because the $Z_k$ are, and covering $X$: the required finite partition.
